items.title: Twenty properties of a morphism survive a flat finitely presented finite order thickening
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The statement extends the finite-order thickening lemma to the case where the target of the deformation is only locally of finite type and the source X' is flat and locally of finite presentation over S', listing twenty properties that transfer across the thickening. The proof follows the same architecture as the unqualified case: base-change stability discharges the forward direction as a citation list, while the converse is done property by property, with general remarks reused across several cases. The finiteness and finite-local-freeness endgame is where the new hypotheses are consumed, since flatness and local finite presentation of X' over S' are needed to conclude properness, finiteness and finally finite local freeness. Retained author proof at lines 2658-2850, the largest in this batch.
